project.name: Nguyen house, 27 Corella Rise
project.summary: The base Nguyen house, but the driveway cut and the rear slab edge affect a neighbour's jacaranda and an on-site blue gum, so an arborist is engaged for an AS 4970 impact assessment and tree protection.

carries.says: Site classification: Class M in accordance with AS 2870

traps.what: Recommends: 'excavate to a depth of 300 mm to remove topsoil under the slab platform', which matches the basement trigger (DOMAIN.md §10 trap 9).
